entries.title: Define a new system or major capability
entries.scenario: Use for goals, scope, functional and quality requirements, not a narrow delta
when_to_use: Use for goals, scope, functional and quality requirements, not a narrow delta
when_not_to_use: A narrow delta to existing behavior; use change-requirements
required_inputs: Capability goals, stakeholders, and system boundary
Functional and quality requirements with rationale and model sources
Measurable acceptance conditions, verification methods, trace, and limits
dependencies: Wish, stakeholder goals, and existing model context
Downstream context, architecture, and verification artifacts

entries.title: Change existing behavior compatibly
entries.scenario: Use for current/proposed behavior, impact and acceptance, not greenfield scope
when_to_use: Use for current/proposed behavior, impact and acceptance, not greenfield scope
when_not_to_use: Greenfield scope with no existing behavior; use system-requirements
required_inputs: Current behavior, baseline requirements, and model sources
Proposed delta, affected requirements, compatibility and migration constraints
Measurable acceptance for new and retained behavior
dependencies: Existing requirements, current model, consumer contracts, and release policy
Regression and new-behavior verification cases

entries.title: Establish system boundary and external interactions
entries.scenario: Use for actors, external systems and exchanged information, not internal decomposition
when_to_use: Use for actors, external systems and exchanged information, not internal decomposition
when_not_to_use: Internal part decomposition alone or runtime node allocation without external context
required_inputs: Boundary ownership, external actors, and model sources
Information flows, interface participants, and external-failure behavior
Context diagram decision, constraints, rationale, and trace
dependencies: Capability scope, external model participants, and exchange definitions
Component-composition and operation-contract documents for internal details

entries.title: Explain internal parts and their relationships
entries.scenario: Use for responsibilities, parts, connections and refinement, not context alone
when_to_use: Use for responsibilities, parts, connections and refinement, not context alone
when_not_to_use: External context alone or runtime node allocation without internal components
required_inputs: Internal part inventory, responsibilities, and model sources
Relationships, interfaces, lifecycle behavior, and composition decision
Constraints, rationale, and model/verification trace
dependencies: System context, requirements, and internal model parts
Interaction and verification artifacts that consume the allocation

entries.title: Describe significant runtime interactions
entries.scenario: Use for participants, ordering and alternate flows, not static data or a pure calculation
when_to_use: Use for participants, ordering and alternate flows, not static data or a pure calculation
when_not_to_use: Static data alone or a simple pure calculation; use data-model or concise prose
required_inputs: Interaction purpose, requirements, participants, and interfaces
Ordered main flow, alternate/error flows, and behavior constraints
Interaction diagram decision and source/verification projection
dependencies: Operation and architecture responsibilities plus model participants
Data contracts and executable verification cases

view_concerns.trigger: Multiple participants or meaningful timing and ordering

entries.title: Specify lifecycle states and transitions
entries.scenario: Use for states, events, guards and recovery, not stateless or one-way procedures
when_to_use: Use for states, events, guards and recovery, not stateless or one-way procedures
when_not_to_use: Stateless behavior or a one-way linear procedure; use interaction-flow or prose
required_inputs: Lifecycle states, invariants, events, and guards
Transitions, terminal states, recovery behavior, and constraints
State diagram decision and source/verification projection
dependencies: Lifecycle requirements, model events, and design responsibilities
Operation contracts and transition verification cases

view_concerns.trigger: Multiple meaningful states and event-driven transitions

entries.title: Define entities, relationships and invariants
entries.scenario: Use for fields, ownership, persistence or exchanged meaning, not interaction sequencing
when_to_use: Use for fields, ownership, persistence or exchanged meaning, not interaction sequencing
when_not_to_use: Interaction sequencing or interface error behavior; use interaction-flow or operation-contract
required_inputs: Entity and field definitions with model sources
Relationships, ownership, lifecycle, invariants, and data decision
Persistence or exchange meaning and verification projection
dependencies: Domain requirements, model elements, and persistence/exchange responsibilities
Serialized data contracts and operation flows

view_concerns.trigger: Relationships are not clear from the schema alone

entries.title: Specify an operation request, response and errors
entries.scenario: Use for a command, query, endpoint or tool operation, not schema alone
when_to_use: Use for a command, query, endpoint or tool operation, not schema alone
when_not_to_use: A data schema with no operation behavior; use data-contract
required_inputs: Operation boundary, participants, request and response shapes
Error behavior, invariants, and version/compatibility policy
Model interaction and verification trace
dependencies: Operation design responsibility, data contract, and model interaction
Orchestration and executable interface tests

entries.title: Specify exchanged or persisted data shapes
entries.scenario: Use for schema, validation, required fields and compatibility, not operation orchestration
when_to_use: Use for schema, validation, required fields and compatibility, not operation orchestration
when_not_to_use: Operation orchestration or domain behavior; use operation-contract or interaction-flow
required_inputs: Schema, required fields, types, units, and participants
Validation, invariants, and version/compatibility policy
Semantic data model and verification trace
dependencies: Semantic data model, serialization format, and consumer versions
Operation contracts and interoperability tests

entries.title: Plan executable verification and analysis
entries.scenario: Use for inputs, environment, procedure and pass criteria, not executed-result claims
when_to_use: Use for inputs, environment, procedure and pass criteria, not executed-result claims
when_not_to_use: Recording an executed result or relying only on inspection; use evidence or design-review
required_inputs: Requirement/design basis and testable units or interfaces
Methods, environment, exact inputs, procedures, and expected results
Measurable pass criteria, trace, and unexecuted/residual limits
dependencies: Testable requirements, identified units/interfaces, fixtures and drivers
Later execution logs and evidence records

entries.title: Plan inspection and semantic design review
entries.scenario: Use for model meaning, design adequacy and source fidelity, not a premature pass
when_to_use: Use for model meaning, design adequacy and source fidelity, not a premature pass
when_not_to_use: Claiming a review has passed before independent judgment; retain a planned review instead
required_inputs: Requirement/design basis and semantic review questions
Exact model/document/figure hashes, source records, and review procedure
Expected judgments, acceptance criteria, and unexecuted/residual limits
dependencies: Identified artifacts, coverage list, source records, and reviewer authority
Later independent review verdict and evidence
